how_opened: GHF outreach to 11 strategic and 18 financial buyers in the week of 03/28/2016, executing the Transaction Committee authorization of 03/24/2016 (#5).

how_opened: Transaction Committee chooses G&W and Party B for confirmatory diligence and merger agreement negotiations because of their higher offers (#35).
who_was_in: 2 strategic admitted: G&W and Party B. Party D and Party E (re-entered 07/29, #40, #41): still being received, not admitted.
